definition: Deviation means a departure from an established course, standard, or norm.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word deviation. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know deviation should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Air traffic controllers noticed a small deviation from the flight plan and radioed the pilot to ask why the jet had drifted south of its approved route.
A variation is a mild, often expected difference within the normal range, while a deviation is a clear departure from the established course or standard.
A deviation steps away from the norm, but defiance openly rejects the rule itself.

A departure is any turning away from a usual course or practice, large or small, and the word stays general. A deviation is measured against something definite — an established course, standard, or rule — so it implies a set line from which the step away can be marked.

Divergence is two paths, trends, or views pulling apart from each other, so it always involves at least two things separating. A deviation is one thing stepping away from a single established course or standard while the standard itself stays put.

An irregularity is a flaw noticed in a record or procedure, something that fails to follow the usual rule. A deviation names the act or instance of departing from a set course or standard, and it can be deliberate, accidental, or simply measured.

Student pilots at the gliding club fly the same rectangular circuit, and the chief instructor grades every turn against it.
The circuit is not a suggestion; its legs and altitudes are printed on a laminated card clipped into each cockpit.

The examiner logged the deviation, measured it, and asked her to explain it on the ground.
